meta.name: salesforce-developer
meta.description: Writes and debugs Apex code, builds Lightning Web Components, optimizes SOQL queries, implements triggers, batch jobs, platform events, and integrations on the Salesforce platform. Use when developing Salesforce applications, customizing CRM workflows, managing governor limits, bulk processing, or setting up Salesforce DX and CI/CD pipelines.

copy.tagline: 编写和调试 Salesforce 平台上的 Apex 代码与 Lightning 组件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在 Salesforce 平台上开发应用或定制 CRM 工作流
copy.tagline_en: Write and debug Apex code and Lightning components on Salesforce platform
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you develop applications or customize CRM workflows on Salesforce

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能编写和调试 Apex 代码、构建 Lightning Web Components、优化 SOQL 查询、实现触发器、批处理作业、平台事件和集成。
howto.when: 当你在 Salesforce 平台上开发应用、自定义 CRM 工作流、管理执行限制、批量处理或设置 Salesforce DX 和 CI/CD 流水线时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个批量更新联系人的 Apex 批处理类。
优化这个 SOQL 查询，避免循环内查询。
say.note: Claude 会检查并重写查询，确保选择性并避免限制违规。

say.text: 为我的 Account 触发器编写测试类，覆盖 200 条记录。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can write and debug Apex code, build Lightning Web Components, optimize SOQL queries, implement triggers, batch jobs, platform events, and integrations on the Salesforce platform.
howto.when_en: Triggered when developing Salesforce applications, customizing CRM workflows, managing governor limits, bulk processing, or setting up Salesforce DX and CI/CD pipelines.

say_en.text: Write a batch Apex class to update contacts in bulk.
say_en.note: Claude will generate best-practice Batch Apex code.

say_en.text: Optimize this SOQL query to avoid queries inside loops.
say_en.note: Claude will review and rewrite the query for selectivity and limit compliance.

say_en.text: Write a test class for my Account trigger covering 200 records.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a test class with bulk scenarios ensuring 90%+ coverage.
